text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"So, my favorite scene in this volume has 
to be the one where the protagonist and 
the enemy hero engage in a valiant duel. 
It was so thrilling!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I understand. As for me, I was thrilled 
that this volume was packed with so many 
elements from real-world mythology.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Another key point was how much realistic 
thought went into it, despite being 
fiction. It actually seemed like a 
plausible training method.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the library, Zenno Rob Roy, 
Mejiro Ardan, and Biwa Hayahide were 
discussing something in hushed voices.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello. I'm sorry, was I being too 
loud?
choice_data_list:
It's okay. What were you guys talking 
about?
It's okay. What were you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We were sharing our thoughts on a newly 
published novel. It was a truly 
fascinating book...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"It's just so fascinating! I have so, so 
much I want to talk about!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, it is a bit of a problem that I 
have few comrades to discuss the latest 
volume with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"That is... just as you say... I can't 
fully vent all my passion for the work."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even though it's so much fun...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be what they call a hidden 
gem? It truly is a bit lonely having no 
one to discuss your thoughts on it with."
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give that novel a read too.
Maybe I'll try reading that novel too.
What do you like best about that book?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be what they call a hidden 
gem? It truly is a bit lonely having no 
one to discuss your thoughts on it with."
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give that novel a read too.
Maybe I'll try reading that novel too.
What do you like best about that book?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could see the spark gleaming in the eyes 
of all three.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? I-I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your concern. Fufu, 
it truly makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This library should have the collected 
volumes too. I'll go grab them right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, Hayahide-san is full of energy as 
well, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All three of them were delighted with my 
suggestion. They really do seem to love 
books.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being able to help them like that filled 
my own heart with joy as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I thought at the time, naively 
optimistic as I was."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"That makes 34 volumes... That's every 
volume of the main series up to the 
latest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before Biwa Hayahide sat a massive 
mountain of books...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"There are still 12 volumes of spin-offs 
in this series. I'll bring those over 
too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hayahide-san. If it's alright with 
you, could you also bring the fanbook for 
this series?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Volume 6 brings back memories! I 
loved the training arc in this volume 
where they become a hero!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should re-read the earlier 
volumes. I might find new insights and 
discoveries.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an extraordinarily long-running 
series. Even I recognized the title at the 
very least.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... That's true. It's tough to 
discuss the latest volume when so few 
people are caught up with it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Was that too much of an imposition after 
all...?
choice_data_list: N-no, that's not true at all...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Really!? I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a Trainer, I can't back down here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the Umamusume's smiles, 
I'll go through fire and water!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, for a while, the late nights 
continued.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! Did that catch your interest!?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, looks like I'll have to fire myself 
up and really show them what I've got.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All three of them somehow began to look 
excited.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You see, this story is about a protagonist 
without any special powers who rises to 
become a true hero!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"The historical backdrop and 
world-building are exceptionally solid. 
It's such a profound novel, it truly feels 
like you're peering into the history of an 
entire world."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist is remarkably 
quick-witted; even within a fantasy 
setting, one can't help but be impressed 
by how realistic and logical it truly is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them happily discussed the 
work together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the three of them looking so happy, 
a warm feeling of joy welled up in my own 
chest as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I thought at the time, naively 
optimistic as I was."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And then, you see! This work has an 
incredible amount of foreshadowing! The 
story is crafted with such meticulous 
precision!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Foreshadowing from volume 3 was finally 
paid off in volume 32 just recently... but 
until then, nobody even realized that that 
scene was foreshadowing in the first 
place!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's a spoiler, so I can't go into 
details, but...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This work incorporates an abundance of 
real-world mythological episodes, making 
it exceptionally rewarding to dissect and 
analyze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Motifs and symbols from past anecdotes 
often connect directly to later stories, 
making it fascinating from a historical 
perspective as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's a spoiler, so I can't go into 
details, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over an hour has passed since they started 
talking. There's no sign that their 
conversation will end anytime soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I totally underestimated their sheer 
fervor...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please read at least up to Volume 8. The 
way it interprets 'the laws of physics in 
a fantasy world' in that volume is both 
unique and brilliant.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That would be a spoiler, so I can't go 
into details.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, speaking of which, in volume 12, the 
protagonist's perspective on what it means 
to be a hero was so fascinating...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The way it analyzes the historical motifs 
depicted in Volume 21 is also quite novel.

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Ardan
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I had no choice but to answer like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer, anything is worth it for the 
Umamusume's smiles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had no choice but to dive headfirst 
into their burning enthusiasm.
